description:
No `BitVec` mutator (`set`, `push_bit`, `bit_xor_into`, `resize`, `clear`, the shifts) is reported to reset `rank_select_index`, so `rank` and `select` read a stale index after a mutation that follows a first query.

## Background

Reported by the gf2-core bit-level comment sweep at `crates/gf2-core/src/bitvec.rs`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A test reproduces the reported behavior at the cited location, or a record shows the report does not hold and the issue is rejected with that evidence.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every mutator invalidates or updates the index; a property test interleaves mutations with `rank`/`select` queries and compares with a scalar reference, including lengths 0, 1, 63, 64 and 65.
title: BitVec mutators leave the rank/select index stale
